BEGIN;

ALTER TABLE course_level
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS course_level_slug_key;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION enforce_track_level_slug_unique()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
DECLARE
    level_slug text;
BEGIN
    SELECT slug INTO STRICT level_slug
    FROM course_level
    WHERE id = NEW.level_id;

    PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(
        hashtextextended(NEW.track_id::text || ':' || level_slug, 0)
    );

    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM track_level relation
        JOIN course_level level ON level.id = relation.level_id
        WHERE relation.track_id = NEW.track_id
          AND relation.level_id <> NEW.level_id
          AND level.slug = level_slug
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'level slug % is already used in track %', level_slug, NEW.track_id
            USING ERRCODE = '23505', CONSTRAINT = 'track_level_track_slug_unique';
    END IF;

    RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

CREATE TRIGGER track_level_slug_unique_trigger
BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF track_id, level_id ON track_level
FOR EACH ROW
EXECUTE FUNCTION enforce_track_level_slug_unique();

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION enforce_course_level_slug_update_unique()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
DECLARE
    linked_track record;
BEGIN
    FOR linked_track IN
        SELECT track_id
        FROM track_level
        WHERE level_id = NEW.id
        ORDER BY track_id
    LOOP
        PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(
            hashtextextended(linked_track.track_id::text || ':' || NEW.slug, 0)
        );

        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM track_level relation
            JOIN course_level level ON level.id = relation.level_id
            WHERE relation.track_id = linked_track.track_id
              AND relation.level_id <> NEW.id
              AND level.slug = NEW.slug
        ) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'level slug % is already used in track %', NEW.slug, linked_track.track_id
                USING ERRCODE = '23505', CONSTRAINT = 'track_level_track_slug_unique';
        END IF;
    END LOOP;

    RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

CREATE TRIGGER course_level_slug_update_unique_trigger
BEFORE UPDATE OF slug ON course_level
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN (OLD.slug IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.slug)
EXECUTE FUNCTION enforce_course_level_slug_update_unique();

COMMIT;
